warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SVR Timing Chain & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: If your Range Rover Sport SVR is a 2015–2022 model with the AJ‑V8 supercharged V8 — that's the L494 generation — timing chain wear and coolant system leaks are well‑documented patterns on this engine, backed by established Jaguar/Land Rover V8 specialist sources. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components, and bearings as standard on every AJ‑V8 rebuild.
